message:
Still running governance, risk and compliance across spreadsheets, shared drives and email? That is usually where gaps appear: a control nobody tested, an obligation nobody owned.

GRC software puts risks, controls, obligations and evidence on one connected platform, so you can see the whole picture and prove it. Our practical guide explains what GRC software does and what to look for.

#GRC #RiskManagement #Compliance

Preparing for ISO/IEC 27001:2022? Most document lists are padded.

Our free checklist sorts 60 items into four tiers: what the standard actually requires, what Annex A adds and what auditors expect to see, each mapped to its clause or control. Download it free.

#ISO27001 #InformationSecurity #ISMS

A risk register that lives in a spreadsheet tends to describe last year's risks.

Enterprise risk management connects strategy, risk appetite and day-to-day decisions across the whole organisation. Our complete guide covers what ERM is, how it differs from traditional risk management, the ISO 31000 and COSO frameworks behind it, and how software keeps it current.

#ERM #EnterpriseRisk #ISO31000

See it before you book a demo.

Our live dashboard tour lets you click through 16 real XGRC® dashboards with sample data: enterprise risk, SHEQ, ESG, incidents, internal audit, vendor risk and AI governance.

#GRC #Dashboards #RiskManagement

Paper registers and inspection spreadsheets cannot keep up with safety, health, environment and quality requirements across several sites.

Our complete guide explains what modern SHEQ software does, from incidents and inspections to audits, actions and legal compliance, and why it has become essential for compliance-driven organisations.

#SHEQ #HealthAndSafety #ISO45001

A risk register is only useful if it is complete and kept current.

Our free risk register template and field checklist sets out the fields a usable register needs, so nothing important is missing when the board or the auditor asks.

#RiskManagement #RiskRegister #GRC

Running ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO/IEC 27001 as separate systems means separate audits, documents and reviews.

PAS 99, the BSI specification for integrated management systems, shows how to run them as one. Our guide covers what it requires and how to implement it.

#PAS99 #IntegratedManagement #ISO

Doing due diligence on a software supplier?

XGRC® Software is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 by BSI (certificate IS 804839), and you can verify it yourself in BSI's public directory. Our Trust Centre sets out how we protect your data: hosting, encryption, recovery objectives and breach notification, with a downloadable Security & Trust Overview.

#ISO27001 #DataProtection #POPIA

Double materiality asks two questions: how sustainability issues affect your business, and how your business affects people and the environment.

Most organisations are ready for the first question and not the second. Our article explains what double materiality requires and how to prepare.

#ESG #DoubleMateriality #SustainabilityReporting

King V applies to financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2026. Is your board ready?

Our King V governance readiness resource helps you check where your governance practices stand against the code's outcomes, and what to strengthen first.

#KingV #CorporateGovernance #SouthAfrica

ISO 31000 or COSO ERM? Both are widely used risk frameworks, but they are built with different emphases, and the one you choose shapes how risk management works in practice.

Our article sets out the key differences, so you can pick the right foundation.

#ISO31000 #COSO #RiskManagement
